cards.card_text: Until Paul comes, Timothy should devote himself to the public reading of ___, to exhortation and to teaching.
cards.verse_text: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to exhortation, and to teaching.
cards.snippet: Until I come, devote yourself to the public reading of Scripture, to exhortation, and to teaching.

cards.card_text: Then the writer says his readers have forgotten an exhortation from Proverbs 3:11-12, one that speaks right to them.
cards.verse_text: And you have forgotten the exhortation that addresses you as sons: “My son, do not take lightly the discipline of the Lord, and do not lose heart when He rebukes you.
